verdicts.issue: Address/framing mismatch: booking platforms list C2U in ตำบลท่าโพ อำเภอหนองขาหย่าง (not ตำบลหนองแก อ.เมือง as in review) and mark it Adults-Only, while the review frames it as family-friendly (ครอบครัว). Hotel itself is correctly identified; score 8.1/828 reviews and ฿800 start price are plausible. Recommend verifying subdistrict/district and the adults-only policy.

Related-hotel card cross-reference price inconsistency: this page lists PaeStay at 'เริ่ม ฿1,500' and Sabua at 'เริ่ม ฿1,400', but those hotels' own priceRange are ฿1,200. Cosmetic cross-link only; the hotel's own data (score 9, ฿1,200) is fine.

Hero score shown as 8.3 while the review body itself and Booking cite ~7.6 (TripAdvisor 4.1/5); Agoda-leaning composite is defensible but the headline 8.3 slightly overstates the real aggregate. Otherwise real, open, ฿1,390 start price and address confirmed.
